summary.zh: 本课讲解 Academic Writing 中常用的 argumentative structures，即用于表达观点、解释原因、提供证据、承认反方观点并进行反驳的论证结构。该语法与写作逻辑密切相关，尤其适用于 PTE Academic Essay、Summarize Written Text、IELTS Writing Task 2 以及学术口语中的观点陈述。中国考生常见问题包括观点直接但缺少论证链、只写原因不写结果、反驳表达过于口语化，以及连接词使用机械重复。掌握本课结构后，考生可以更清晰地组织段落，提高 coherence、cohesion、grammar range 和 academic tone。

structure.formula: Claim + Reason / Explanation + Evidence / Example + Result / Implication + Concession or Refutation
structure.explanation: Argumentative structures 的核心不是单一句型，而是一组用于构建逻辑论证的表达方式。一个完整的学术论证通常先提出 claim，即明确立场；然后用 reason 或 explanation 解释原因；接着用 evidence、example 或 data 支撑观点；最后说明 result、implication 或 broader significance。如果涉及对立观点，还需要使用 concession 承认其合理部分，再用 refutation 说明其局限。PTE 和 IELTS 写作中，高分答案通常不是堆砌复杂词汇，而是通过清晰的论证链展示逻辑严密性。

examples.en: Governments should invest more in public transport because it can reduce traffic congestion and lower carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 政府应该在公共交通上投入更多资金，因为这可以减少交通拥堵并降低碳排放。

examples.en: Although online learning offers flexibility, it cannot fully replace face-to-face education because students often need direct interaction and immediate feedback.
examples.zh: 虽然在线学习提供了灵活性，但它不能完全取代面对面教育，因为学生通常需要直接互动和即时反馈。

examples.en: This suggests that environmental policies are most effective when they combine regulation with public education.
examples.zh: 这表明，当环境政策将监管与公众教育结合起来时，其效果最为明显。

usage_scenarios.title: 提出明确立场
usage_scenarios.description: 在 argumentative essay 的 introduction 或 body paragraph 开头，需要清楚表达自己的 claim。学术写作中应避免使用过于绝对或情绪化的表达，而应使用 measured language，如 largely, tend to, in many cases 等，使观点更客观。

examples.en: In many cases, stricter environmental regulations are necessary to ensure sustainable economic development.
examples.zh: 在许多情况下，更严格的环境法规对于确保可持续经济发展是必要的。

examples.en: It is reasonable to argue that technology has transformed the way students access information.
examples.zh: 可以合理地认为，科技已经改变了学生获取信息的方式。

usage_scenarios.title: 解释原因
usage_scenarios.description: 提出观点后，需要说明 why。常用结构包括 because, since, as, due to the fact that, this is mainly because。PTE 写作中，原因解释要直接，不宜写过长从句导致语法错误。

examples.en: This is mainly because urban residents rely heavily on private vehicles when public transport is unreliable.
examples.zh: 这主要是因为当公共交通不可靠时，城市居民会严重依赖私家车。

examples.en: The policy may fail because it does not address the underlying causes of unemployment.
examples.zh: 该政策可能会失败，因为它没有解决失业的根本原因。

usage_scenarios.title: 提供证据或例子
usage_scenarios.description: 证据可以是 research findings、statistics、real-world examples 或 general observations。考试写作中不一定需要真实数据，但例子必须与观点直接相关，不能泛泛而谈。

examples.en: For example, cities that have expanded metro systems often experience a gradual decline in car dependency.
examples.zh: 例如，扩建地铁系统的城市通常会逐渐减少对汽车的依赖。

examples.en: Research in educational psychology has shown that timely feedback can significantly improve learning outcomes.
examples.zh: 教育心理学研究表明，及时反馈可以显著改善学习效果。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达结果和影响
usage_scenarios.description: 论证不能停留在原因层面，还要说明结果或影响。常用表达包括 as a result, consequently, therefore, this may lead to, this can contribute to。注意 therefore 和 because 不能在同一个简单句中重复连接。

examples.en: As a result, students may become more independent and better prepared for higher education.
examples.zh: 因此，学生可能会变得更加独立，并为高等教育做好更充分的准备。

examples.en: This can contribute to a more equitable distribution of educational resources.
examples.zh: 这有助于教育资源更加公平地分配。

usage_scenarios.title: 承认反方观点
usage_scenarios.description: 高分 argumentative writing 通常会承认 opposing views。承认反方不是削弱立场，而是展示 critical thinking。常用结构包括 although, while, it is true that, admittedly, some people argue that。

examples.en: Admittedly, banning private cars in city centres may inconvenience some commuters.
examples.zh: 不可否认，禁止私家车进入市中心可能会给一些通勤者带来不便。

examples.en: While social media can spread misinformation, it also enables people to access news rapidly.
examples.zh: 虽然社交媒体可能传播错误信息，但它也使人们能够快速获取新闻。

usage_scenarios.title: 反驳对立观点
usage_scenarios.description: Refutation 用于说明反方观点的局限。常用结构包括 however, nevertheless, this argument overlooks, this view fails to consider, the problem with this argument is that。反驳时应保持学术语气，避免使用 completely wrong 或 nonsense 这类情绪化表达。

examples.en: However, this argument overlooks the long-term economic benefits of a healthier workforce.
examples.zh: 然而，这一观点忽视了更健康的劳动力所带来的长期经济效益。

examples.en: This view fails to consider that disadvantaged students may not have equal access to digital devices.
examples.zh: 这一观点没有考虑到弱势学生可能无法平等地获得数字设备。

common_mistakes.wrong: Because public transport is cheap, so people should use it more.
common_mistakes.correct: Because public transport is cheap, people should use it more. / Public transport is cheap, so people should use it more.
common_mistakes.explanation: 中文中常说“因为……所以……”，但英文中 because 和 so 通常不能同时连接同一个主从关系。考试写作中应选择一个连接方式，避免 double conjunction。

common_mistakes.wrong: I think government must solve this problem because it is very bad.
common_mistakes.correct: Governments should address this problem because it has serious social and economic consequences.
common_mistakes.explanation: 原句过于口语化，very bad 缺乏学术具体性。Academic Writing 中应使用更精确的名词短语，如 serious social and economic consequences。

common_mistakes.wrong: Some people think online education is good. But I disagree.
common_mistakes.correct: Although online education provides flexibility, it is unlikely to replace traditional classrooms entirely.
common_mistakes.explanation: 原句逻辑过短，缺少 concession 和 reason。使用 although 可以先承认反方合理性，再表达更成熟的判断。

common_mistakes.wrong: This policy can make people have better life.
common_mistakes.correct: This policy can improve people’s quality of life.
common_mistakes.explanation: make people have better life 是中式英语。学术写作中常用 improve people’s quality of life，注意 life 在此结构中通常需要所有格 people’s 和固定搭配 quality of life。

common_mistakes.wrong: The reason is because many students lack motivation.
common_mistakes.correct: The reason is that many students lack motivation. / This is because many students lack motivation.
common_mistakes.explanation: The reason is because 属于常见冗余表达。标准学术英语中应使用 The reason is that，或直接使用 This is because。

common_mistakes.wrong: Everyone knows that technology is important.
common_mistakes.correct: It is widely acknowledged that technology plays an important role in modern education.
common_mistakes.explanation: Everyone knows that 过于口语化且绝对。学术写作应使用客观表达，如 It is widely acknowledged that，并用 plays an important role 替代简单的 is important。

common_mistakes.wrong: If children use phones, they will be bad at study.
common_mistakes.correct: Excessive smartphone use may have a negative impact on children’s academic performance.
common_mistakes.explanation: 原句存在表达不自然和过度绝对的问题。学术表达中常用 excessive, may, have a negative impact on, academic performance 来提高准确性。

common_mistakes.wrong: This example can prove my opinion.
common_mistakes.correct: This example supports the argument that early intervention can reduce educational inequality.
common_mistakes.explanation: prove my opinion 过于主观，也不符合学术写作语气。更自然的表达是 supports the argument that，后接完整观点。

pte_usage.description: Argumentative structures 在 PTE Academic 中非常重要，尤其影响 Written Discourse、Grammar、Vocabulary 和 Content 分数。PTE Essay 需要考生在短时间内形成清晰立场，并用原因、例子和结果支撑观点。Summarize Written Text 虽然不是完整议论文，但也需要识别原文中的 claim、cause、contrast 和 implication。口语项目如 Retell Lecture 和 Summarize Spoken Text 中，考生也常需要用 This suggests that, The speaker argues that, However, the issue is that 等结构概括论点关系。
sections: Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It can be argued that + clause
There is a strong case for + noun / gerund
This argument is based on the assumption that + clause
academic_patterns.translation: 这一论点建立在……的假设之上

academic_patterns.pattern: The main reason for this is that + clause
One possible explanation is that + clause
This may lead to + noun phrase
This can have a significant impact on + noun phrase
academic_patterns.translation: 这可能对……产生重大影响

academic_patterns.pattern: While it is true that + clause, it is also important to note that + clause
academic_patterns.translation: 虽然……是事实，但同样重要的是要注意……

academic_patterns.pattern: This view fails to consider that + clause
A more balanced approach would be to + verb
This does not necessarily mean that + clause
The long-term implications of this are considerable.
academic_patterns.translation: 这所带来的长期影响是相当显著的。

ai_tips: 写 PTE Essay 时，每个主体段可以使用“观点句 + 原因 + 例子 + 结果”的四步结构，避免只列观点而不展开。
如果题目要求 discuss both views，应至少使用一个 concession 结构，例如 While some people argue that..., this view fails to consider...。
不要频繁重复 I think。学术写作中可使用 It can be argued that, This suggests that, The evidence indicates that。
PTE 写作中复杂句应服务于逻辑，而不是单纯追求长度。若一个句子超过三层从句，错误风险会明显增加。
在反驳时避免情绪化词汇，如 stupid, wrong, terrible。应使用 overlooks, fails to consider, is limited by 等学术表达。
主体段结尾最好写一句 implication，说明该观点带来的结果或意义，这有助于提升论证完整度。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写得更学术：I think online learning is good because students can study anywhere.
practice_questions.answer: Online learning offers considerable flexibility because it allows students to access educational resources regardless of location. 中文：在线学习提供了相当大的灵活性，因为它使学生能够不受地点限制地获取教育资源。

practice_questions.question: 用 although 写一个让步论证句，主题是 social media。
practice_questions.answer: Although social media can facilitate communication, it may also contribute to the spread of misinformation. 中文：虽然社交媒体可以促进交流，但它也可能导致错误信息的传播。

practice_questions.question: 纠正句子：Because public libraries are useful, so governments should fund them.
practice_questions.answer: Because public libraries are useful, governments should fund them. / Public libraries are useful, so governments should fund them. 中文：因为公共图书馆很有用，政府应该为其提供资金。

practice_questions.question: 用 This view fails to consider that... 反驳观点：University education should be completely online.
practice_questions.answer: This view fails to consider that many students benefit from face-to-face interaction, practical training and immediate feedback. 中文：这一观点没有考虑到许多学生会从面对面互动、实践训练和即时反馈中受益。

practice_questions.question: 完成句子：The main reason for this is that...
practice_questions.answer: The main reason for this is that many low-income families cannot afford private educational resources. 中文：其主要原因是许多低收入家庭负担不起私人教育资源。

practice_questions.question: 用 result structure 改写：More people use private cars. Air pollution becomes worse.
practice_questions.answer: As more people rely on private cars, air pollution is likely to become more severe. 中文：随着更多人依赖私家车，空气污染可能会变得更加严重。

practice_questions.question: 判断并修改不自然表达：This example can prove my opinion.
practice_questions.answer: This example supports the argument that effective public transport can reduce traffic congestion. 中文：这个例子支持了有效公共交通可以减少交通拥堵这一论点。

practice_questions.question: 写一个完整论证句，包含 claim、reason 和 implication，主题是 environmental education。
practice_questions.answer: Environmental education should be introduced at an early age because it can shape children’s habits and contribute to more sustainable behaviour in the long term. 中文：环境教育应该在儿童早期引入，因为它可以塑造孩子的习惯，并从长远来看促进更可持续的行为。
